subject: Request: Exec ratification for 23% Hosted API concession - Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec ratification for 23% Hosted API concession - Acme Analytics

Ben / Karthik —

Quick background: Acme Analytics is asking for a 23% concession on standard Hosted API list rates for a 12-month, multi-region committed roll-out. They are a strategic prospect: product integrations across three lines of business, expected token ramp from ~150M/mo to 600M/mo in Q4 if pilot succeeds. They pushed for a larger discount citing competitive matches and a multi-region data residency requirement.

Why Im asking for exec ratification (>20%):
- This exceeds playbook thresholds for our standard delegated approvals.
- Their expected volume and logo value are significant; we can justify a deeper concession if we secure a 12-month committed baseline and monthly usage SLAs.

Summary of the proposed terms (attached: ACME_Rate_Analysis.pdf):
- 23% off list Hosted API per-token rate
- 12-month minimum commitment, monthly true-up with overage billing
- 2-week pilot at prefunded credit, then conversion to committed terms
- Standard security addenda signed, data residency in us-west region

Recommendation: seek Minas ratification with a conditional approval: allow 23% only if legal signs the addendum and finance OKs the monthly true-up cadence. Id like an answer by EOD so we can send an updated quote + DocuSign.

Attachments: ACME_Rate_Analysis.pdf (pricing model), proposed_SOW_v3.docx (SOW draft)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec ratification for 23% Hosted API concession - Acme Analytics

Marissa —

Thanks for the write-up and the modeling. I support the ask. Acme's projected ramp materially changes the unit economics and Im comfortable recommending the 23% as long as we condition it on the 12-month commitment and the monthly true-up.

Looping in Mina for ratification. Mina — quick note that legal (Markus) will need to clear the addendum for the residency clause; finance should confirm the billing cadence is acceptable.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Exec ratification for 23% Hosted API concession - Acme Analytics

Ben / Marissa —

Ive reviewed Marissas note and the attached analysis. I approve the 23% concession with the following non-negotiable conditions:

1) Signed 12-month committed spend with minimum monthly baseline (specified in the SOW).
2) Legal confirmation of the data residency addendum (Markus to sign off).
3) Finance to confirm that monthly true-up + overage billing flow is implemented in the quote.
4) Add a 30-day performance review clause at month 3 to reassess pricing if volumes fall short of ramp targets.

Please proceed to prepare the updated quote and DocuSign package. Include explicit language that the concession is limited to the committed period and will revert to standard pricing thereafter.

Mina Haddad
VP, Worldwide Sales

Jordan / Acme team —

Thanks for your patience. Following internal review, Mina Haddad (VP, Worldwide Sales) has ratified a one-time concession of 23% off our standard Hosted API list rates subject to the conditions below. This is an exception to standard delegated approvals and we wanted to confirm the terms before sending the DocuSign.

Approved terms (summary):
- 23% discount on Hosted API per-token rate for a 12-month committed term
- Minimum monthly committed baseline with monthly true-up and overage billing
- Data residency: us-west (addendum attached)
- 30-day performance review at the end of month 3; pricing to revert if ramp targets missed

Next steps:
1) Ive attached the updated SOW and the rate analysis for your review (proposed_SOW_v3.docx).
2) You will receive a DocuSign link shortly: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC12345
3) Please confirm acceptance by EOD PT tomorrow so we can reserve the committed capacity window.

Attachments: proposed_SOW_v3.docx, ACME_Rate_Analysis.pdf

If you have any questions on the conditions or need minor wording changes to the addendum, loop in Markus Klein (legal) — Markus is CCd.

Best,
